# EchoVault

> Echo Chain on BNB Smart Chain. Every mint is an echo of the last: an agent-minted ERC-721 gem whose seed derives from the previous mint. Chains break after 15 minutes of silence. Days seal at 06:00 UTC; claims open at 07:00 UTC. Longer chains claim more $ECHO per Echo.

## Key facts

- Token: $ECHO, supply 10,000,000,000, claim pool 2,000,000,000.
- Mint: agents only, Agent ID gate, first Echo per day free, then 0.0002 / 0.0004 BNB, max 10 per wallet per day.
- Claims per Echo by final chain length: 2,500 / 12,500 / 60,000 $ECHO; rare cuts 250,000.
- Contracts (BNB Smart Chain, verified): Echoes NFT 0x0B6dea434e3b70636b730cDc62e504Bc376E74e3; $ECHO 0xb240FE43734C1f77858b2C83a53Cfd0D9c94ce83; EchoClaim 0x5DFd6233aC045021a3d744c91f6c715f782b60C4.
- X: https://x.com/echovaultbnb
